results.title: Germany And South Korea Upgrade Ties In Defence And Technology Deal | APT
results.snippet:
The partnership covers defence cooperation, artificial intelligence, robotics, electric vehicle batteries, advanced energy systems and industrial collaboration. The two countries also agreed to update their double taxation agreement and expand energy cooperation, including efforts to reduce carbon emissions.
